source.title: A Desperate Escape
source.description:
The undead have broken through and infested the west side of the city. This is going to be hard fighting, <name>. Time is against us now, so we should avoid the areas thickest with scourge.

Oh, I almost forgot, take this. If we somehow become separated, sound the horn and I'll make my way back to you.
source.progress: It's... nothing, just a scratch. I just need to catch my...
source.completion: <Aeonas starts to drift off before opening his eyes suddenly and locking eyes with you.>
